to: 2. You need two credits on customer accounts: one applied in full to an invoice, and separately one that has been voided. To apply one in full: click "Customers" in the top menu, open a customer that has an unpaid invoice worth MORE than the credit and no deposit on the account, click the "Invoices" tab, click "Issue Credit", type the amount, choose "Issue Store Credit", type a short note and confirm; then tick the credit's row and the invoice's row together, click "New Payment", type the credit's amount in that invoice's "Payment" box, choose any "Payment method" if "Make payment" is greyed out, and click "Make payment" - the credit's "Status" then reads "Applied". To void the other one: on its row, in the "Action" column, hover the icons and click the one whose tooltip reads "Reverse", then click "Reverse" in the "Reverse Credit" window that asks you to confirm - its "Status" then reads "Voided".
